caption: A clear round glass bowl filled with water rests on a plain beige surface, seen from a fixed high angle. A loose cluster of translucent white ice cubes floats on the surface, with a bright curved line near the top marking the bowl's inner rim reflection. The pieces drift and reorganize slowly across the water, the upper-left cube moving inward while the central and right pieces shift toward the right. A lower-center cube remains near the bottom of the bowl, serving as a relatively fixed reference as the surrounding pieces translate past it. Over the sequence, the floating cubes grow smaller and fainter, their edges softening and blurring. A broad horizontal bright band spreads across the water. The remaining ice settles as dim white blobs nearer the center and lower-left, more submerged than before. The bowl rim, background and framing stay constant throughout.
relations: As the ice melts, the floating cubes gradually shrink and become fainter in the water.
The ice cluster slowly drifts and reorganizes across the surface, with pieces moving inward and right.
A broad horizontal bright band of light reflection spreads across the water as the ice melts.
The lower-center cube remains relatively fixed near the bottom while surrounding pieces translate past it.
